# QS-CFW-5753-95 Quality specification - track link CFW-5753-95 (15B37)

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P2  
Parts: CFW-5753-95

Scope
This quality specification defines acceptance criteria and inspection methods for track link CFW-5753-95 (CFW-5753-95) manufactured at Plant P2. It applies to all finished forgings delivered as track links CFW-5753-95 and covers mechanical hardness, dimensional bore tolerance, and maximum forging weight.

Requirements table

| Parameter | Requirement | Acceptance |
|---|---|---|
| Hardness | The hardness range for track link CFW-5753-95 (CFW-5753-95) is 34-37 HRC. | Accept if within range; reject if outside range. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for track link CFW-5753-95 (CFW-5753-95) is ±0.03 mm. | Accept if measured value falls within tolerance band; reject if outside band. |
| Forging weight | The maximum forging weight for track link CFW-5753-95 (CFW-5753-95) is 28.3 kg. | Accept if part weight is at or below maximum; reject if above maximum. |

Inspection method
- Hardness: Perform Rockwell hardness testing on finished track link CFW-5753-95 (CFW-5753-95) at designated locations using calibrated equipment. Report individual readings and the averaged result per part. Ensure testindenter and scale correspond to HRC procedures.
- Bore diameter: Measure bore diameter on finished parts using calibrated bore gauge or CMM. Record measured diameter and compare to nominal drawing dimension using The bore diameter tolerance for track link CFW-5753-95 (CFW-5753-95) is ±0.03 mm.
- Weight: Weigh the finished forging on a calibrated scale and compare to The maximum forging weight for track link CFW-5753-95 (CFW-5753-95) is 28.3 kg. Document measured mass on inspection records.

Nonconformance handling
Parts failing any requirement in the Requirements table shall be segregated and tagged. Engineering disposition shall be requested and documented. Rework is permitted only if proven processes can return the part to conformance without compromising integrity; otherwise parts shall be scrapped. All nonconformance actions and final dispositions must be recorded in the quality system records and retained per company retention policy.
